detailed_description:
About Scope

What is Scope Battle Royale?

Scope is a high-stakes, 100-player battle royale where survival means everything and freedom is the ultimate prize. Set on a remote island deep in the ocean, players take on the roles of memory-wiped warriors trapped in high-tech robotic suits. Each has been kidnapped, trained, and forced to fight in a ruthless tournament where only one can rise.

Dropped from a transport plane into a sprawling, ever-shrinking battlefield, players must explore dense mountain forests to open grassy plains—scavenging for weapons, supplies, and the upper hand. With no special abilities to rely on, only strategy, reflexes, and raw skill will separate the victor from the fallen.

Stylized visuals, intense solo or squad action, and a mysterious backstory lurking beneath the surface make Scope more than just a fight—it's a test of who you are when everything else has been stripped away.

Do you have what it takes to survive the Scope?

History of Operation Games

Operation Games was started by Steven Benoit Jr in 2020, at the time he was 12 years old. Steven loved to play video games and he always used to wonder how they where made. When he got his first PC he started looking up how to program. He started learning Unity, but he didn't like that way of programing, he wanted something easy for beginner's. After a while Steven started using Unreal Engine 4. He liked the easy viewport and blueprint programing. Steven then thought about putting together a small team to help him make video games. So at school he asked his friends and they all wanted to help. So they called the team "Epic Crazy Games". But that was to familiar with "Epic Games". So Steven renamed the team to "Operation Games".

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or Intel i7-9700k
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 8GB, AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i9-12900K or AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 16GB, AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
